title: Scenario cards carry a tier (control | starter | delivery); control cards are internal checks and are never exported
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ② maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, verbatim (Claude Code session, 2026-11-06). After seeing the screenshots of the AI-built CRM app from the second live run, they asked 「这样的场景可以交付给客户吗？会不会太简单？」, then answered the seat's proposal 「我接受你的建议」:
- control cards are internal quality checks only, never exported or shown;
- mid-tier cards are shown in the gallery as starter templates;
- a delivery-grade tier is added (its scenario list goes to the maintainer for review separately).

**The Chinese-UI requirement in the same proposal was withdrawn**, verbatim: 「中文界面要求 不需要」. This card was edited to remove it.

Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#3600.

## Problem

Nothing in a card says whether it is a control card or a gallery candidate. Today the exporter (#30349) could publish a 2-object, 8-row control app (`crm_account_with_contacts`) as if it were a product.

## Ask

1. **Card field `tier`**: a closed enum `control | starter | delivery`, required on every card by the loader.
   - Set `control` on `crm_account_with_contacts`, `invoice_with_line_items` and `project_with_tasks`.
   - Set `starter` on the six mid-tier cards.
   - The loader refuses a `starter` or `delivery` card below a floor stated in the PR. Example floor: ≥ 5 objects, ≥ 100 seed rows, ≥ 10 questions, ≥ 3 personas. The six mid-tier cards already meet it (measured: 7–8 objects, 496–757 rows, 10 questions, 3 personas).
2. **Exporter rule.** #30349 exports only `starter` and `delivery` cards whose run passed every half. A `control` card is never exported, whatever its score. This card owns the field; #30349 owns the filter.
3. **Gallery wording.** `objectstack-ai/gallery`'s README and AGENTS.md are hand-written. The epic seat updates them once this lands. Nothing for the lane there.

Out of scope: the delivery-grade scenario list (maintainer review first).

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`.
